answer: My answer to sybils is Signed mobile plan tenure with carrier attestation — a plan the carrier billed to one number across years — which makes the shale of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Fakes fail here because a plan the carrier billed to one number across years is tied to something outside the network; the sonnet of the attack is that the farm must now operate in the physical world, where clones are slow and visible. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the spiral of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
